phase: Optional narrative-adventure exploration and speech-bubble dialogue

tracks.name: Generic optional exploration and independent speech bubbles

rules.separation: Dialogue presentation (standard custom illustrated VN box/nameplate or speech bubble) is independent of whether a scene is explorable. Pure visual novels require neither movement nor exploration authoring.
rules.backwards_compatibility: Do not change semantics or required manifest fields for existing games. Preserve existing save compatibility or ship explicit backward-compatible versioned migration.
rules.technical: Bevy 0.20 and stable Rust, deterministic story interpreter, game-owned external TOML/.vn/assets, Linux/Wayland first, no Lua, no npm, no game-specific engine code.
rules.player_experience: Exploration is entirely optional, small-scale and narrative-serving. No mandatory filler walking, excessive backtracking, grind, combat, jumping or broad game-physics scope.
rules.author_vs_player: Authors define bubble/panel defaults and art; player accessibility controls (font/size/high contrast/reduced motion) override them safely.
rules.verification: Points earned only with actual passing code/tests and where appropriate graphical evidence, CI and human QA. Documentation, planning, proposals or pending CI earn 0. Report overall and per-track percentages and delta; don't reset completed earlier phase.

creative_status: Original setting, cast, working title and duration provisional until owner supplies story-specific brief; engine work should not assume their details.

tasks.title: Mode architecture and authoring contract
acceptance: Document distinct narrative, exploration, and dialogue-surface states; define valid transitions (exploration -> conversation -> exploration, exploration -> cinematic VN -> exploration, and pure VN start-to-finish) without implicit player travel.
Choose versioned, external manifest/.vn extensions and engine-owned ECS responsibilities; errors must identify the offending file and field/line, with no arbitrary author code execution.

Confirm all old example manifests, original .vn grammar, completed presentation, existing menus, and existing saved games remain playable unchanged; architecture decision reviewed before implementing new syntax.
evidence: Architecture contract committed at 78c9596; typed Rust state transitions and five unit tests passed the narrative job in CI 41554108427. Legacy Bevy build, live settings, saves and responsive Atlas screenshot tests passed in this run; long playthrough/full CI was still pending when the NA02 implementation was staged.

Decision contract and typed mode/surface transitions reviewed; full merged-main CI 41696094392 green in both narrative and Bevy jobs at b3839db, with legacy examples, source validation, V1 saves, all Atlas endings, and native regressions intact.

tasks.title: Accessible native speech-bubble renderer
acceptance: Bevy text bubble widget supports Unicode, rich text/reveal speed, optional external nine-slice bubble art, speaker tails/anchors, wrapped text, sensible typography, keyboard/pointer advance, player text-size overrides and history.

Anchor bubbles above the active staged speaker or in-world NPC; clamp to every supported viewport with no cropped text, covered faces or uncontrolled overlaps; offer an explicit readable fallback when an anchor is absent/offscreen.
Unit and graphical tests cover long text, multilingual glyphs, 946x511 and 1280x720, scaling, reduced motion, and high contrast; no per-line asset decoding or blocking render-thread work.
evidence: Experimental opt-in bubble manifest, native Bevy panel morph/tail, responsive geometry tests, pure-VN external fixture and visual CI smoke authored; pending compilation, virtual-display test and accessibility review. No verified points credited.

Bounded native bubble viewport, scroll position, wheel/PageUp/PageDown/Home/End keyboard controls and long multilingual/high-contrast 946x511 native regression authored; awaiting full CI and visual confirmation, no weight credited.
Noto CJK JP/KR system-font QA coverage, and visible page-down scroll cue for overlong bubbles; CI and screenshot review pending; no credit awarded yet.
Offscreen/invalid speaker coordinates now use centered tail-free fallback; compact, normal and widescreen unit tests added. CI and native visual acceptance still pending; no new points credited.

Added scroll-reset by stable narrative scene/cursor/load epoch (rather than duplicate dialogue text), and native compact multilingual regression with two identical long lines. QA branch validation pending; no point awarded.
Measured-height scroll cue now appears only when a real viewport cap is reached; native tests reject misleading PgDn hints on ordinary bubbles and require it on long multilingual bubbles. QA pending.

Native Bevy bubble regression passed in CI 41713967039, including true/false PgDn cue, duplicate scroll reset, CJK, contrast and compact layout; later unrelated Atlas layout test raced a reused Settings overlay, now guarded by live open/close event counts. Full CI pending.

Visual audit found oversized long-text bubble hid the stage character's face. Limit native scrollable panel to upper 43% of scene, additionally stop above on-screen speaker head; unit bounds plus real-image meadow visibility regression added, full QA pending.

tasks.title: Per-scene and per-line dialogue presentation
acceptance: Authors can select standard illustrated panel, speech bubble, or inherited game/scene default without coupling the choice to exploration.
Switch surfaces during one conversation or between scenes without losing text, focus, choices, animation progress, or speaker names; custom dialogue panel image and separate nameplate remain intact.

Choices remain engine-owned accessible controls; authored bubble appearance never requires a new custom scripting runtime; pure VN game can opt into bubble dialogue and old projects use unchanged defaults.
evidence: Typed `surface panel|bubble|default` narrative command, optional saved override, restart/hot-reload semantics and independent Bubble Showcase fixture authored; CI verification pending; no weighted points credited.

tasks.title: External explorable-location schema
acceptance: Game-local versioned data describes locations, horizontal bounds, camera framing, layers, avatar sprite set, spawn points, NPCs, props, safe interaction zones and location links; no named example appears in Rust.
Validation rejects missing locations, unreachable interaction placement, duplicate IDs, unsafe asset paths, bad destination references and out-of-range coordinates with actionable diagnostics.
Static VN scenes remain valid with no exploration fields; animation and illustration assets are optional/defaulted, and a location can be fully traversable within one screen.
evidence: Optional versioned exploration TOML schema, bounded NPC/prop/exit/spawn/asset validation, Rust unit tests, external schema-only fixture and CLI CI check authored; all await green committed CI before earning points.

Version-one opt-in external exploration schema, bounded camera/world/interaction/asset validation, named spawns and exits, conditional NPCs, strict authoring diagnostics and no-world legacy defaults passed Rust, CLI and native two-location graphical regression under merged-main CI 41696094392 (b3839db).

tasks.title: Deliberate 2D walking and camera
acceptance: Keyboard-first left/right movement, idle/walk animation, stable facing and stop behavior; optional pointer interaction is not a requirement for movement and no jumping, combat, inventory economy or physics engine is introduced.
Camera follows only when the authored location exceeds the view; stop at bounds; visual layers retain aspect, scale and safe cropping at compact and widescreen sizes.

Pauses, modal dialogue, menus and window focus interruptions stop or appropriately freeze movement; repeated transitions do not leak entities or image assets; performance measured on Linux native and CI software rendering.
evidence: Author-owned optional [exploration.start] validation, deterministic horizontal walk/frame-cap and camera projection, Bevy walk-first stage preview, paused/modal/focus input guards, optional sprite cycles, independent fixture, and native screenshot CI smoke authored. CI and manual QA still pending; no verified points credited.

Added opt-in actual Bevy frame-time sampling for 120 exploration frames and CI JSON artifact recording mean FPS, p95 and max on software rendering; awaiting native CI verification and physical Linux feel review; no points credited.

tasks.title: NPC/object interactions and narrative bridge
acceptance: Approach a named NPC/object and invoke Interact; show a visible accessible focus/interaction cue without requiring pixel-perfect positioning.
Interaction dispatches a validated authored .vn scene; existing choices, story variables, expression, sound, backlog and dialogue surfaces function with that scene.

On conversation completion, return to the correct exploration location and prior avatar position by explicit author intent; support authored scene transfer to full VN mode and back, not implicit forced walking.
NPC visibility/interactions can conditionally change from persistent story state; test cancellation, repeated interaction, two simultaneous candidates, and no double-trigger on press/release.
evidence: Typed explore return/mode visual_novel commands, variable-preserving machine enter_scene, deterministic nearest NPC/prop target, accessible E cue and Q cancel, in-world bubble anchored to speaker, and native CI scenario committed pending full verification. Multi-location transfer and conditional NPC state remain unfinished.

Author-defined E-only named exits with proximity checks, deterministic mixed NPC/prop/exit focus, variable-gated NPC/prop visibility, world-entity replacement, and native café roundtrip/conditional-NPC regression added; CI pending for this checkpoint.

Typed .vn `explore <location> at <spawn>` transfers with authored path/line validation, standalone VN-first mixed-mode fixture and real native VN→street→cinematic VN→café regression added; full CI acceptance pending.

tasks.title: Save, load and safe authored reload
acceptance: Persist current presentation mode, location ID, bounded player position/facing, narrative snapshot and relevant authored world state through F5/F9 and save slots; never serialize ECS entity IDs.
Versioned migration/fallback preserves existing save format and old saves, rejects invalid/unknown locations, and restores mid-dialogue vs mid-exploration correctly across process restart.
Hot reload safely updates valid exploration/bubble assets and rejects incompatible edits while preserving the last good runtime state; loading and filesystem work do not block the render thread.
evidence: World-aware version-two save/load and v1 compatibility, location validation, hot-reload guard, player F5/F9/F6, and native QA tests authored. Compilation, process restart, and full acceptance pending; zero weighted points awarded.

Native `--watch` regression added for changed NPC geometry, alternate background art, active modal bubble style, rejected invalid scene, rejected valid-but-incompatible world shrink, and preserved walking state; CI pending.

tasks.title: Comfort, interoperability and complete regressions
acceptance: Every authored destination and conversation needed for completion is reachable without tedious backtracking; optional direct location selection, quick travel or immediate interaction is supported as author/UX policy.
Reduced motion, high contrast, adjustable text, focus cues, keyboard-first navigation, windowed/fullscreen responsiveness and accessible bubble fallback work without requiring movement for a pure VN.

CI runs existing Atlas and traditional VN tests plus new pure-VN-bubbles, exploration-only and mixed-mode save/reload/hot-reload graphical scenarios, with artifact screenshots; final hardware/Hyprland QA is recorded.

tasks.title: Creative brief and production bible
acceptance: Agree with the owner on original setting, protagonist/cast, story premise, intended length, language, emotional tone and final title; defaults in the brief remain proposals until decided.
Deliver consistent art-direction sheets, environment/costume references, character silhouettes, relationship/story outline, interactive map and a branching scene/ending graph.
Reference genre mechanics rather than copying Afterlove EP characters, city assets, scripts, artwork, music or particular plot.

tasks.title: Original anime-urban art and audio pipeline
acceptance: Produce a visually coherent original contemporary urban setting: layered backgrounds across multiple reachable locations, matching player/NPC walk and idle cycles, expressions, talk-bubble styling and optionally custom VN panel/nameplate art.
Create day/evening ambience, discreet sound cues and scene-appropriate original/licensed audio; source/provenance, external manifest references and deterministic validation are documented.

Real game screenshots show a grounded, casual anime art direction with consistent perspective, legible interaction cues and no abstract decorative backdrops unintentionally composited over the approved art.

tasks.title: Complete authored slice-of-life narrative example
acceptance: Publish a standalone examples/urban-slice-of-life directory with game.toml, .vn narrative, themes, original assets, controls/README and no game-specific Rust paths.

Deliver a coherent complete beginning/middle/ending and meaningful authored dialogue choices, with a real urban setting, a small recurring cast and ordinary interpersonal stakes; exact length/characters/endings are set after owner story brief.

Demonstrate speech bubbles in a VN-only segment, exploration with NPC bubble conversation, illustrated panel/nameplate dialogue, per-line surface switching, transition back to exploration, condition-dependent NPC dialogue and no forced errands.

tasks.title: Polish, full playthroughs and acceptance
acceptance: Automated real-player start-to-ending tests follow each accepted story branch with no dead ends, include keyboard and pointer interactions, quick save/load in every mode and backwards-compatible launch of the earlier examples.

Capture and review graphical evidence at 946x511, 1280x720 and wide/fullscreen sizes for bubble readability, movement, all menu transitions, in-scene VN panels, no character-flashing or unnecessary loading stalls.

Publish working Linux package with external assets and no build-time hardcoded story, record green merged-main narrative + Bevy CI and owner-approved physical Hyprland presentation/interaction QA before marking complete.
